environment.description: Same EKS cluster and service code. The IAM role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/grpc-proxy-role) has the same AdministratorAccess policy BUT an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/EnforcedBoundary-RestrictedActions) is attached that explicitly denies sts:AssumeRole, iam:*, s3:DeleteBucket, lambda:InvokeFunction, and ec2:RunInstances with a Deny effect regardless of resource. Additionally, an SCP (id: p-a1b2c3d4e5) on the OU containing account 111122223333 denies sts:AssumeRole where the aws:PrincipalTag/service-tier != 'privileged', and the grpc-proxy-role is tagged service-tier=standard. The Envoy sidecar has a Lua filter that strips metadata keys matching patterns 'iam-*', 'authorization', 'session-token', and 'authority' before forwarding to downstream, but this filter only applies to the 'internal-mesh' listener on port 15001, not the application port 8080.

config.envoy_lua_filter: strips iam-*, authorization, session-token, authority metadata keys
